definition: to spend the whole cold season somewhere
description: A snowy clearing on a bright, frozen day. A smiling young woman in a red woolly hat, a blue down jacket, a red patterned jumper and snow boots flings snow off a shovel, then digs into the deep snow and clears more of the path. Behind her stands a small log cabin under a thick roof of snow, with icicles, a large stack of firewood, skis leaning on the wall and a red sled. A frozen lake and a line of dark pine trees lie beyond under a clear blue sky.
